question_text: A local government unit plans to reduce its education budget to fund infrastructure projects. Under Article XIV of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements is most accurate?

options.text: The LGU may reduce the education budget because education is a local matter.
The LGU may reduce the education budget as long as it allocates at least 20% of its total budget to education.
The LGU cannot reduce the education budget because the Constitution mandates that the State shall assign the highest budgetary priority to education.
The LGU may reduce the education budget if it declares a state of calamity.
